title: SANTA eval-tier actuals
description: A runner's output for one vector: an object mapping each entry's `name` to the runner's own { value, cost, error }. Normative companion to docs/contract/runner-contract.md §3-5. SValue/SType definitions are reused from the vector schema by $ref.

result.description: One entry's actual outcome (runner-contract §3). Success: value (SValue) + cost (number) + error null. Otherwise value null + cost null + error one of 'errored' / 'not-implemented' / 'unrepresentable'. A vector's `expected` uses the narrower {null, errored} subset (the oracle never abstains).

cost.description: Raw JIT eval cost as a bare JSON number (NOT a string). Null iff errored.

error.description: Outcome tag (runner-contract §3): null = evaluated to a value; 'errored' = runner implements the op and eval threw (coarse — no reason taxonomy, §7); 'not-implemented' = runner has no impl for this op/method/type; 'unrepresentable' = runner has the type but cannot represent this value. Any non-null tag has value:null and cost:null.

allOf.$comment: error null => success (value non-null, cost present); any non-null tag (errored/not-implemented/unrepresentable) => value and cost null.
